root_cause.text: The function `pipapo_drop()` unconditionally reads `rulemap[i + 1].n` to pass as an argument to `pipapo_unmap()` on every iteration, including the last one where `i == m->field_count - 1`, causing an out-of-bounds stack read beyond the `rulemap` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `last = i == m->field_count - 1` and replaces `rulemap[i + 1].n` with `0` when `last` is true, matching the commit message: "pipapo_drop() passes rulemap[i + 1].n to pipapo_unmap() as the to_offset argument on every iteration, including the last one where i == m->field_count - 1. This reads one element past the end of the stack-allocated rulemap array." KASAN output confirms the out-of-bounds read at offset 164, exactly 4 bytes past the array.
